text: When a program doesn't work as expected, finding the bug can be challenging. The key is to adopt a systematic approach rather than making random changes. First, try to reproduce the bug consistently to understand its behaviour. Then, use debugging tools like breakpoints in your code editor to pause execution and inspect variables step by step. Another effective technique is logging: adding print statements or log messages helps track the flow of data and catch errors early. By isolating different parts of the code and testing each one carefully, you can identify the exact source of the problem and fix it efficiently.
